submitted.rationale: Index 25 (Mn0.49Sr0.51, near SrMnO3 stoichiometry) gave 4.26e-6 A photocurrent, over 400× the other two measured points, which were both at the 1e-8 A floor. XRD showed the same dominant pattern across the whole line with only small lattice shifts, so it could not tell phases apart. The merit therefore appears to peak sharply near the 1:1 composition.
